notes: Boss-stage target factory defaults for the current 4-target board. This file is a committed schema/default reference; the ESP does not auto-load it at runtime. Actual device runtime config is written to NVS by serial provision/config JSON or MQTT config messages. Runtime provisioning persists identity, human-readable display_name, Wi-Fi, MQTT, gameplay, target/HP LED settings, and OTA policy in NVS; hardware_profile is validated against the compiled firmware as a compatibility guard, not used for live pin remapping. HP bar rendering groups the 300 LEDs as 100 vertical HP columns across 3 horizontal rows and drains by hp_remaining / hp_max ratio with depleted columns off. Active match progress such as hp_remaining and active_target_index is intentionally not persisted. Boot/reset keeps all LEDs off with internal HP full until a start command is received; start runs a 5-second fast neon-rainbow orbit intro before ACTIVE target play.
